name: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd
about: Gulf Oil Lubricants Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, marketing and trading of automotive and non-automotive lubricants.[1] It is among the top three lubricant companies in India among private players.[2]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The Co’s product portfolio comprises Automotive Lubricants, Industrial Lubricants and Specialty Oils, Marine Lubricants, EV Fluids, and AdBlue. It caters to the automotive, industrial, and marine sectors. [1]

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.07%.
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 58.5%
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.91%
